tasks.title: Extend StructuredLogger API to accept legacy NestJS Logger 3-arg signatures
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: An autonomous migration replaced NestJS Logger imports with StructuredLogger across ~200 backend files but did NOT update the call sites — leaving 215 tsc errors. Stop the bleeding with a backwards-compat shim on StructuredLogger, then commit.

FILES TO READ:
- backend/src/logging/structured-logger.ts (current API)
- backend/src/admin/auth/admin-mfa.service.ts:149 (a sample TS2554 call site — 3 args)
- Any 5 random files from `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'TS2554\|TS2345' | head -10` to understand the call patterns.

FILES YOU OWN:
- backend/src/logging/structured-logger.ts — add backwards-compat overloads:

  log(message: string, context?: string): void;
  log(message: string, extra?: LogExtra): void;
  log(message: string, extraOrContext?: string | LogExtra): void { ... }

  error(message: string, stack?: string, context?: string): void;
  error(message: string, extra?: LogExtra): void;
  error(message: string, stackOrExtra?: string | LogExtra, context?: string): void { ... }

  warn(message: string, context?: string): void;
  warn(message: string, extra?: LogExtra): void;
  warn(message: string, extraOrContext?: string | LogExtra): void { ... }

  debug + verbose: same pattern.

  When the second arg is a string, treat as context — store it in the LogExtra under {context: <value>}. When it's an object, treat as LogExtra. The 3-arg form (error only) combines stack + context into {stack, context}.

  Static .from() can stay as-is.

DO NOT EDIT:
- The call sites themselves (other tasks will adjust where the shim isn't enough).
- scripts/pulse/*
- scripts/migrate-structured-logger.ts (untracked, not yours).

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | wc -l
  (expected: large drop from 215 down to <30, ideally <10)
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='structured-logger' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -10

COMMITS:
- feat(logging): StructuredLogger accepts legacy NestJS Logger 3-arg signatures (compat shim)
- test(logging): cover legacy + new logger signatures

FINAL REPORT: tsc error count before/after, new test count, sample legacy call that now passes.

tasks.title: Remove TS6133 unused-import stale declarations from the migration sweep
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: The StructuredLogger migration left 57+ TS6133 'declared but never used' errors across backend — old imports the migration didn't clean up. Remove them.

FILES TO READ:
- Run: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'TS6133' | head -60
- Each file in that list is a candidate.

FILES YOU OWN: All backend/src files reporting TS6133.

RULES:
- Only remove identifiers that tsc TRULY confirms unused (TS6133 error). Don't speculatively delete anything else.
- If an import has multiple names and only one is unused, remove just the unused one: `import { A, B }` → `import { A }`.
- If the entire import becomes empty after removal, delete the whole `import` line.
- For TOP-LEVEL unused functions (vs unused imports), prefer adding `void <name>;` at file bottom OR prefixing with `_` IF the function is genuinely a helper that may be exercised later (judgment call). Default: remove if zero callers exist anywhere in the repo (grep to confirm).
- For unused LOCAL variables inside function bodies, remove or prefix with `_`.
- Run tsc after every ~10 files patched to confirm no regressions.

DO NOT EDIT:
- StructuredLogger itself (sibling task handles it).
- scripts/pulse/*
- scripts/migrate-structured-logger.ts.
- The compat shim or new logger overloads added by the sibling task.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'TS6133' | wc -l   # target: 0
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | wc -l  # should drop

COMMITS:
- chore(backend): remove TS6133 unused imports from structured-logger migration sweep

FINAL REPORT: TS6133 count before/after, file count touched, sample of imports removed.

tasks.title: Fix residual TS2345/TS2554 call-site mismatches after compat shim lands
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: After the structured-logger-api-compat sibling task lands its shim, most TS2554/TS2345 errors should auto-resolve. Clean up the residual ones that don't fit the shim — e.g., calls that pass an Error object as the second arg where shim still rejects.

NOTE: Wait until the api-compat task has committed before starting heavy work. If it hasn't committed yet (grep `git log --oneline | head -5` for 'StructuredLogger accepts legacy'), report 'waiting on api-compat' and exit with code 4 cleanly.

FILES TO READ:
- backend/src/logging/structured-logger.ts (after compat shim)
- cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E 'TS2345|TS2554' | head -40

FILES YOU OWN: Backend files with residual TS2345/TS2554 errors after the shim lands.

RULES:
- For each error, READ the exact line, understand what the caller intended, and adjust:
  - If caller is doing `logger.error(msg, err.stack)` and the shim only accepts string|LogExtra, wrap: `logger.error(msg, { stack: err.stack ?? '' })`.
  - If caller is doing `logger.error(msg, err)` with `err: unknown`, normalize: `logger.error(msg, { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) })`.
  - If caller passes 3 args `(msg, stack, context)` and shim's 3-arg overload still rejects, switch to 2-arg: `(msg, { stack, context })`.
- NEVER use `as any` or @ts-ignore.
- Run tsc every ~10 files patched.

DO NOT EDIT:
- StructuredLogger itself.
- scripts/pulse/*
- scripts/migrate-structured-logger.ts.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | wc -l   # target: 0
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='auth|kloel|whatsapp' --no-coverage --maxWorkers=2 2>&1 | grep -E 'Tests:' | tail -5

COMMITS:
- fix(backend): adapt residual logger call sites to StructuredLogger API after shim

FINAL REPORT: TS2345/TS2554 count before/after, file count touched, sample call-site transformation.
